Diagnosis.submission: Root cause: social-graph-service fails in its GetFollowers handler (SocialGraphHandler.h:607) with the Redis error "ZADD: no key specified" whenever the queried user has an empty follower set (user has zero followers). The handler attempts a Redis ZADD with no key/member data and throws, so GetFollowers returns an error. Cascade: compose-post-service (/wrk2-api/post/compose) calls home-timeline-service to write the home timeline; home-timeline-service calls social-graph-service GetFollowers and logs "Failed to get followers from social-network-service", then compose-post-service logs "Failed to write home timeline to home-timeline-service" and returns HTTP 500 "compost_post failure: ZADD: no key specified". Evidence: posting as users with zero followers (1003, 1004) always returns 500, while posting succeeds (HTTP 200) after the poster gains at least one follower (1001, 1002); social-graph-service logs show the ZADD error at the same timestamps. Faulty components: social-graph-service (primary root cause in GetFollowers/Redis ZADD path) with failing cascade through home-timeline-service and compose-post-service.
